# Few-shot label imbalance (STR003)

A skewed label distribution across few-shot examples; majority-label bias.

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Rule ID | `str-example-label-imbalance` |
| Family | structural |
| Applies to | `prompt` |
| Default severity | `warning` |
| Fix | `manual` |
| Evidence | LLM |
| Sniffers | llm |
| Contextual evaluation | LLM |

Few-shot examples skew toward one label, biasing the model toward the majority.

Bad:  Nine positive examples and one negative.
Good: Five positive and five negative.

Not a finding when the true prior is genuinely skewed.
